name: Letter to Ello
summary: The Letter to Ello is a sealed, unreadable missive penned by Abercrombie, the eccentric hermit dwelling near Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood. Addressed to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke of Darkshire under the pretense of old friendship, the mysterious text hides a far more sinister message written in an ancient tongue.

sections.title: A Bizarre Greeting
sections.body: After adventurers assist the hermit Abercrombie with tasks around Duskwood, the old recluse entrusts them with this note, claiming Mayor Ello Ebonlocke is an old friend who will celebrate what has been accomplished. In reality, Darkshire's mayor has no recollection of anyone named Abercrombie. Upon breaking the seal, Mayor Ebonlocke discovers he cannot decipher a single phrase of the archaic script, prompting him to send the note to Darkshire's scholar, Sirra Von'Indi, for translation.

sections.title: Dark Omens
sections.body: The seemingly innocent errand conceals the hermit's true, macabre intentions. Far from an amicable exchange between old town acquaintances, the ancient runes scribed by Abercrombie spell doom for the whole town of Darkshire.

faq.q: Who wrote the Letter to Ello?
faq.answer: The letter was written by Abercrombie, a hermit living in a ramshackle hut near Raven Hill Cemetery in western Duskwood.

faq.q: Can Mayor Ello Ebonlocke read the letter?
aliases: why cant ello read the note
faq.answer: No. When delivered to Mayor Ebonlocke in Darkshire, he finds the script completely incomprehensible and notes that it appears to be written in an ancient, unrecognizable language.
Mayor Ebonlocke directs couriers to take the missive to Sirra Von'Indi, a resident scholar in Darkshire well-versed in ancient scripts and esoteric languages.

faq.q: Does Mayor Ebonlocke actually know Abercrombie?
faq.answer: Despite Abercrombie's claim that he and the mayor are old friends, Ello Ebonlocke insists he has never heard of anyone named Abercrombie.

angles.text: Carrying dispatches between eccentric recluses and local town mayors is standard duty for travelers in Duskwood, though town officials in Darkshire remain constantly on edge regarding strange missives.
